# Set79 Path A: original attached wallet to scheduled DAILY payout

This external harness is source-only until the root agent approves its exact
execution lock. It uses the existing schema14 account/vault/recipient owner on
an isolated byte copy of the closed Set73 baseline6, a fresh DAILY operator with
separate schema16 custody, normal loopback nodes, real TLS clients and the actual
automatic worker/outbox. It does not run the headless command or native UI.

The independent reference is `reference/source-ready.json` (49b53496), qualified
by both Python interpreters at `artifacts/set79/attachment-reference-attempt1`.
The identical 46,498-byte output is SHA256
`a48a854d20298fced726b816d11690aa45e9f4184e3b161cbc7c258b74897386`.
It preserves both original recipient scripts and all ExpectedLocal fields,
selects the real compact block target as the pool target, and independently
rebinds the new remote source/config identities. The original all-ones prospect
policy is unchanged. The true derived ordinary maximum remains two; no physical
or logical limit changes at runtime.

One explicit Start runs the actual attached worker. Stop/Logout join it before
reading its outbox. A second original controller login is stopped throughout;
its old view is refused, rows remain identical, and the attached wallet must
observe the scheduled payment. Exactly one or two accepted canonical rewards
are permitted, including the Stop race. The independent fee branches are 141
or 209 atoms, miner payments 990,000,000 or 1,980,000,000 atoms, and operator
change 9,999,859 or 19,999,791 atoms. No manually issued/submitted winning share
stands in for this worker.

Pending pool/admission work is neither discarded nor relabeled accepted. A
full intake can retain a signed fighter admission with a capacity response;
this known product boundary remains visible. Every retained authorization is
verified; acknowledged births and any lost acknowledgment are reconciled with
the complete closed original issuer. This case does not require all pending
admissions to resolve or claim that stopped reopen runs recovery.

Maturity is mined on the isolated normal chain before the selected actual UTC
minute. The schedule and operator perform the real payment; no clock or signing
substitution is used. A transparent RPC relay records public signed sends
without injecting errors. Complete source/round/ledger audits occur only after
the runtime joins. The final audit binds exact funding, payments, fee, change,
claims, one batch and public balance/history pages. All attempted sends must
retain the original raw bytes. The other enrolled gym receives zero.

`provenance.json` identifies the reused sources. `runtime_helpers.go` extracts
the qualified Path B constructors without its fault relay. `node_helpers.go`
changes only node-home admission to require the pre-copied existing directory;
`operator_audit.go` uses the original full DAILY audit chain before bounded
public projections. The runner/support inherit the prior source/profile/group
and baseline-copy machinery. Original source trees and all 226 immutable copied
history/control paths must remain exact. Synthetic private trees are retained
on success or failure and are not public report artifacts.

The normal probe is CGO1 (required by Darwin protected-file ACL checking), the
normal node CGO0, both under the exact candidate no-CSE profile, offline module
cache and GOMAXPROCS=2. Each dependency query is bounded at 120 seconds and each
build at 240 seconds. The scenario remains 900 seconds, outer capture 1080
seconds, maximum chain height 180; the selected successful case additionally
requires final height 103–105. No automatic retry of a failed attempt exists.
Every original process group must join without forced signals for a pass.

Root invocation after reviewing and creating the approved successor lock:

```sh
python3 /Users/taytrrip/slug/set79-prep/public-daily-attachment/run.py \
  --execute \
  --approved-lock /absolute/path/to/execution-lock.approved.json \
  --approved-lock-sha256 EXACT_APPROVED_SHA256 \
  --attempt public-daily-attachment-actual-attempt1
```

The proposed lock is not execution authorization. Root must bind any subsequently
qualified product changes before approval. `report.json`, `actual-report.json`
and the nine named public phases preserve failures and final evidence identities.
This finite synthetic account test is not 64-miner load, continuous capacity,
public deployment, production authentication, D74 review, or the separate Path B
full-intake/expired-winner/reserved-payout acceptance.

The preserved `pre-money-read` successor adds only bounded pure money-read
retries and partial-payment/refusal evidence; see `MONEY_READ_SUCCESSOR.md`.
